name: AppleGameUI
summary: Makes the game's own studded HUD work: live money with a count-up and +N pop, the wave banner and countdown, the base's health bar, a shop with each item's 3D model, locks until an item's wave, upgrades with levels and prices, messages, button press feel and sounds.

needs.screen: StarterGui.AppleHUD as stud-ui.ts waveDefenseHud builds it (Coins, Wave, Health, Menu, Toast, ShopPanel with Item_<id> cards, UpgradePanel with Up_<id> rows). Pieces it cannot find are skipped.
needs.config: ReplicatedStorage.AppleComponents.AppleClientConfig: { currency, words = { wave, nextWave, left, base, cleared, lost, pick, earn, shop } }
needs.state: ReplicatedStorage.AppleState (AppleWaves); AppleCatalog, AppleItemModels and AppleUpgrade (AppleShop); AppleClientState; AppleSounds (fx)

gives.screen: every label shows the game's real value; every button acts
gives.progress: cards lock until their wave, upgrade rows show level and price and buy the next level
